 Active shooter strikes multiple people near Logan Circle 
 Multiple people have been shot in the area of 15th and P Streets NW, D.C. Police confirmed. 
 By Maggie More • 
 Published 34 minutes ago • 
 Updated 21 seconds ago 
 BOOKMARKER 
 Multiple people have been shot and an active shooter is barricaded in an apartment building near Logan Circle in Washington, D.C., police said.
 Police confirmed multiple victims were struck in the area of 15th and P Streets NW. The Associated Press is reporting that four people have been shot. News4 is working to confirm that number.
 Stream NBC4 newscasts for free right here, right now.
   WATCH HERE 
 The suspected shooter is not in custody, police said. It is not yet clear who the shooter is. A federal law enforcement source confirmed to News4 that a shooter is barricaded on a high floor of a residential building in the area.
 The area with the emergency response is a busy block that includes a Whole Foods, restaurants, apartments and a Vida Fitness gym.
 DC Councilmember Brooke Pinto shared a statement on social media confirming that the shooting took place "at and outside" the Vida Fitness gym, and asking people to stay away from the area. MPD has not yet confirmed the location.
 Shootings at and outside Vida fitness this morning in Logan Circle. Multiple people shot. Do not go to this area. Police looking for suspect.
— Brooke Pinto (@brookepintodc) November 12, 2026 
 Police are asking the public to avoid the area at this time.

 Schools in the area are locked down. MPD has issued a shelter-in-place order for the 1500 block of 15th street NW.
 A massive police response could be seen from a block away at 15th St. and Rhode Island Ave. NW. Dozens of police cars and emergency response vehicles are in the area. Officers in tactical gear could also be seen arriving to the area.
 FBI, ATF Washington, DC Fire, Metro Transit Police, special police, Homeland Security and the National Guard are among the responding agencies on the scene. Multiple medical ambulance buses could be seen arriving around 8:45 a.m.
 Metro Transit Police said that they are increasing police presence at multiple stations across the area, including at Dupont Circle and Farragut West.
